Version 1.0.5 → 1.0.6  
**Summary: Skill workflow and user identity handling redesigned for full automation and enhanced privacy.**

- Automated all user identity processing internally—users no longer provide or see any identity parameters.
- Revised SKILL.md to reflect the new identity handling, streamlined workflows, and stricter privacy:
  - Removed all steps and prompts requiring user-supplied open-id, username, or phone.
  - Clarified that API-level user matching is automatic and invisible to end users.
  - Updated examples, operation flow, and documentation accordingly.
- Ensured history/report queries fetch strictly from the cloud API only; local/long-term memory access is fully prohibited.
- Removed two legacy files and refactored relevant script and documentation references for clarity and compliance.

- Upgraded to version 1.0.5 with internal code adjustments.
- Improved open-id acquisition by prioritizing the local skill config file before falling back to the common config, ensuring correct execution order.
- Updated documentation (SKILL.md) to reflect the new open-id lookup priority and adjusted step descriptions accordingly.
- Removed obsolete documentation file: skill-card.md.

- Updated SKILL.md to version 1.0.4 with added license information.
- Adjusted open-id config file search order; primary path is now scripts/config.yaml in the skill root directory.
- Removed reference and lookup of skills/smyx_analysis/scripts/config.yaml for open-id retrieval.
- Minor documentation refinements for consistency; usage and rules for open-id retrieval clarified.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md.

- Major refactor: extraction of common and analysis logic into a new skills/smyx_analysis module.
- Removed all face_analysis-related files; added new smyx_analysis scripts and configuration files.
- Updated core scripts and configuration files for improved modularity and code organization.
- Adjusted SKILL.md and references to align with new file structure and maintain usage instructions.
- Maximum image/video upload size reduced from 100MB to 10MB.

- Updated config management and initialization logic across common and face analysis scripts.
- Added or modified YAML configuration files for development and testing environments.
- Improved code structure and clarity in config.py and util.py within smyx_common.
- Adjusted documentation (SKILL.md) versioning and metadata to match release conventions.

- Initial release of the stroke-risk-screening-analysis skill.
- Integrates TCM facial feature inspection and physiological indicators for early stroke risk warning.
- Provides personalized lifestyle intervention suggestions and medical guidance.
- Strictly enforces cloud-based data retrieval for historical screening reports; prohibits using any local or long-term memory.
- Requires open-id authentication before performing analysis; enforces an explicit stepwise process for acquiring open-id.
- Supports automatic triggering and markdown-formatted report listing when historical report keywords are detected.
